response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with strong web, backend, and open-source credentials, but the profile is a poor match for this embedded LAN-switch security role. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel source analysis/modification experience, and no exposure to switch firmware, L2/L3 networking protocols, MACsec, 802.1X, or chip-vendor SDKs. C experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, with recent work almost entirely in TypeScript/Node and D. Multiple mandatory qualifications are unmet.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across many stacks
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, test frameworks, DevOps
Some low-level/systems exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux, high-performance async services)
concerns: No indication of Japanese language ability (native-level is a hard requirement)
No embedded firmware, network switch, or security protocol (MACsec, 802.1X) experience
No Linux kernel investigation or source-modification experience; C skills dated and secondary

key_factors.factor: Limited/dated C and Linux kernel depth
